dx_raw:
DIAGNOSIS: Multiple sclerosis (clinically isolated syndrome with brainstem involvement causing left internuclear ophthalmoplegia and a myelopathic component, despite initial normal MRI and CSF)

1. MOG antibody-associated disease (would explain INO and transverse myelitis pattern if MOG-IgG positive)
2. Neuromyelitis optica spectrum disorder (cannot exclude without AQP4-IgG testing and full spinal cord imaging)
3. Brainstem encephalitis of other autoimmune/infective cause (e.g., anti-GQ1b spectrum disorder, Lyme, sarcoid)
